title: [SOA] Allow changing or clearing manually selected contacts
summary: Users can now select, change, or clear manually chosen contacts in the Sales Order Agent through a dedicated lookup interface and assist-edit, with changes isolated to one-time overrides that don't modify underlying contact fields.
key_points: New contact lookup page allows matching both E-Mail and E-Mail 2 fields without standard restrictions
Users can change a previously selected one-time contact or clear the mapping to return to email-based matching
Changes are isolated to task-message overrides; existing contact email fields remain unmodified
Authorization checks continue to restrict mapping changes to configured owner or agent
Backward compatible - existing contact matching unchanged until user explicitly selects a contact
quote: Users can now select the correct contact directly from the duplicate-contact notification.
